name: agent-conduct-guidance
description: Consolidated, generally-good agent conduct guidance for Copilot CLI: one plugin hosting multiple independent ambient modules, each a concise checked-in instruction projection plus a paired on-demand skill. Modules: process-spawn hygiene (spawn every ad hoc CMD/PowerShell/Python/Node/etc. child process headlessly, especially on Windows), coordinator-first delegation (route broad separable research, comparisons, evaluations, domain-tool calls, and disjoint bulk edits into bounded sub-agent contexts while the coordinator retains synthesis, integration, and completion), and scratch-space hygiene (resolve a portable scratch root and a timestamped per-task subfolder before writing an ad hoc working file outside a repository, instead of littering a drive root with undated loose files). Designed to absorb further similarly-scoped conduct guidance as its own module rather than proliferating single-purpose plugins.
